tools.name: accept_connection_suggestion
tools.title: Accept Connection Suggestion
tools.description: Accept a connection suggestion — draws a permanent edge in the Mind graph.

tools.name: accept_suggestion
tools.title: Accept Weave Suggestion
tools.description: Accept one Weave review-queue suggestion by its id (from weave_list_suggestions). A tag row threads the tag through every note it names, a connection draws the edge, an entity link weaves the mention, and an alias merge folds two hubs into one, which is not undoable. A role question ('who is your ...') is answered in the Margin app.

tools.name: add_accountability_partner
tools.title: Add Accountability Partner
tools.description: Add a family member as an accountability partner for a habit. They'll be able to see your progress and get notified on misses/streaks. Adding someone who is already a partner replaces their notification settings.

habit_id.description: ID of the habit to share

partner_id.description: User ID of the accountability partner

notify_on_miss.description: Notify partner when you miss a day

tools.name: add_checklist_item
tools.title: Add Checklist Item
tools.description: Add an item to a checklist

tools.name: add_comment
tools.title: Add Card Comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a card, as the signed-in person. Suited to leaving an answer, a status update or a hand-off note on the card, where the team will see it. Markdown is rendered. The comment appears in the board's activity feed and is visible to everyone who can open that board. The board is taken from the card; it cannot be set.

pin.description: PIN, if the card's board is PIN-locked

tools.name: add_family_connection
tools.title: Add Family Relationship
tools.description: Add a family connection between two people. Supports multiple relationship types (e.g., someone can be both a partner AND a parent). Automatically creates the inverse relationship. Adding a connection that already exists replaces its is_primary flag and metadata.

relationship_type.description: Type of relationship from first person's perspective

tools.name: add_family_member
tools.title: Add Household Profile
tools.description: Add someone to the household who has no email and no account (a child, a grandparent) so they can be given chores, allowance and points. Owner/admin only, and only in a family workspace. They count against the plan's family-member limit.

avatar_emoji.description: Emoji shown as their face (they have no photo)

family_role.description: Their role in the household (default: child)

pin.description: Optional 4-6 digit PIN for the shared family device. Stored hashed; never readable back.

tools.name: add_meal
tools.title: Add Meal to Plan
tools.description: Plan a meal into a slot (date × breakfast/lunch/dinner/snack) — a saved recipe by id, or free text like 'leftovers' / 'eat out'

title.description: Free text when there's no recipe

servings.description: Servings to cook (omit for the recipe default)

tools.name: add_meal_ingredients_to_list
tools.title: Add Meal Ingredients to Shopping List
tools.description: Put ONE planned meal's ingredients on the shopping list (the grocery list), scaled to that slot's servings, deduped against what's already unchecked, each row keeping provenance back to the meal.

list_id.description: Omit for the workspace's first list

tools.name: add_meals_to_list
tools.title: Add Week's Ingredients to Shopping List
tools.description: Pull this week's planned meal ingredients onto the shopping list, which makes the week's grocery list from the meal plan. Deduped against what's already there, each row keeping provenance back to its meal or recipe. Idempotent.

week_of.description: Any date in the week (YYYY-MM-DD); default today

tools.name: add_shopping_item
tools.title: Add Shopping Item
tools.description: Add an item to the household's shopping list, which is where groceries go: 'add chamomile tea to the groceries' and 'put milk on the grocery list' are both this. Files the item by aisle, creates the Groceries list on first use, and dedupes against unchecked items already on the list. The app marks it quietly as added through this connection.

is_staple.description: A recurring staple (kept for one-tap re-adding)

tools.name: add_whiteboard_elements
tools.title: Add Whiteboard Elements
tools.description: Draw on a whiteboard: append rectangles, ellipses, diamonds, text, arrows, lines, or freehand strokes from simple specs. clear=true replaces the canvas, which removes what was on it. Coordinates are canvas pixels. Shapes are drawn from the specs given; no image is generated by a model.

clear.description: Replace existing canvas instead of appending

tools.name: append_to_note
tools.title: Append to Note
tools.description: Append text to the end of an existing note, continuing whatever list or prose the note already uses. Suited to a thought that belongs inside a note the person already keeps, where create_note would start a new one.

tools.name: apply_template
tools.title: Apply Template
tools.description: Apply a template as a card (default), a note, a standalone checklist, a whiteboard, or a set of habits. target chooses which, and variables fill {{placeholders}}. note: body + steps as checkboxes. checklist: standalone checklist, grouped by `# heading` section via category_tag. whiteboard: one column of sticky notes per section. habits: one habit row per step (headings skipped).

tools.name: assign_card
tools.title: Assign Card
tools.description: Put a person on a card. A card can carry several assignees; this adds one and leaves the rest alone, and assigning the same person twice changes nothing. The person must already be a member of the card's board, exactly as in the app's assignee menu: assigning someone who cannot open the board would create work they never see. assignee_user_id is a user id from list_workspace_members.

assignee_user_id.description: The person taking the work (not you, unless you are assigning yourself). Must be a member of the card's board.

pin.description: PIN, if the card's board is PIN-locked

tools.name: assign_chore
tools.title: Assign Chore
tools.description: Assign a chore to a family member.

tools.name: assign_label
tools.title: Add Label to Card
tools.description: Assign a label to a card

tools.name: assign_to_house
tools.title: Assign Member to House
tools.description: Assign a family member to a house for the house points competition. Pass null house_id to unassign.

user_id.description: Who to place in the house. A member of this workspace or a household profile in it; anyone else is refused.

tools.name: award_points
tools.title: Award Points
tools.description: Award house points to a family member. Points contribute to their level and their house's total.

user_id.description: Who gets the points. A member of this workspace or a household profile in it; anyone else is refused.

tools.name: check_feature
tools.title: Check Plan Feature
tools.description: Check whether a workspace's plan includes a feature (same resolver as the entitlement gate). Fails open.

tools.name: check_shopping_item
tools.title: Check Off Shopping Item
tools.description: Check an item off the shopping or grocery list, or uncheck it with checked=false. Records who and when.

tools.name: claim_debt
tools.title: Send Debt Record to Counterparty
tools.description: Send a money-owed record to the person it names so they can agree or disagree. Only works for someone already connected to you here.

tools.name: claim_shopping_run
tools.title: Claim or Release Shopping Run
tools.description: Claim the shopping run ('I'm at the store', 'I'll get the groceries') so two people don't both buy milk. release=true hands it back.

tools.name: clear_reminder
tools.title: Clear Card Reminder
tools.description: Remove/clear a reminder from a card

card_id.description: The card ID to clear reminder from

tools.name: complete_card
tools.title: Complete Card
tools.description: Mark a card as complete

tools.name: complete_chore
tools.title: Mark Chore Done
tools.description: Mark a chore done. It then waits for a parent or admin: nothing is credited and no points move until verify_chore approves it (needs_verification says whether a reward is waiting). When a parent does a chore themselves, the app's Done button performs both steps; here that is complete_chore followed by verify_chore.

completed_by.description: User who completed it (defaults to current user)

tools.name: contribute_to_savings_goal
tools.title: Record Savings Goal Contribution
tools.description: Record a contribution toward a savings goal: the amount is set aside from the member's ledger balance into the goal, with a matching ledger entry in the same transaction. Both are records inside The Margin; no real money is moved.

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.title: Convert Currency
tools.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another using latest exchange rates

tools.name: copy_note
tools.title: Get Note as Plain Text
tools.description: Return a whole note as one block of text, title first. Suited to handing a complete note to someone, where get_note returns it in pages.

tools.name: create_agent_config
tools.title: Create Agent Config
tools.description: Create a new agent configuration
JSON string

tools.name: create_allowance
tools.title: Create Allowance
tools.description: Set up a recurring allowance for a child. On each payday (next_payout_date, then every week, two weeks or month) the amount is recorded on their balance in the family ledger: money owed to them. No money is moved. With auto_payout (the default) the server records it on payday; with auto_payout false a parent adds it in the app. Cash actually handed over is a separate payout record (record_ledger_entry, entry_type payout).

auto_payout.description: true (default): the server adds the amount to the child's balance on payday. false: a parent does it by hand.

tools.name: create_allowance_pool
tools.title: Create Shared Allowance
tools.description: Record one pot of pocket money shared between several children by a rule: equal, percentage (values sum to 100) or exact (values sum to the pot). Each child keeps their own allowance row with the resolved amount. A child has one allowance, so a child who already has one gets it replaced by their share of this pot (amount, frequency and next payout date). Like every allowance, it records what each child is owed; no money is moved.

pool_total.description: The pot, decimal as a string

value.description: Percentage or exact amount, per the rule

tools.name: create_board
tools.title: Create Board
tools.description: Create a new board. By default no columns are added. A 'columns' array gives custom column names suited to the board's purpose, and 'include_default_columns' true adds generic To Do / In Progress / Done columns.

columns.description: Custom column names to create for this board (e.g. ['Backlog', 'Design', 'Development', 'QA', 'Done']). Order is preserved. If omitted and include_default_columns is false, the board is created with no columns.

include_default_columns.description: If true and no custom columns provided, creates generic To Do / In Progress / Done columns. Defaults to false.

tools.name: create_card
tools.title: Create Card
tools.description: Create a new card in a column. The app marks it quietly as added through this connection.

priority.description: Card priority. Use 'normal' for medium priority.

tools.name: create_chat_thread
tools.title: Create Chat Thread
tools.description: Start a chat thread with people you share a workspace with or are connected to. Two people makes a direct thread; more makes a group.

subject_type.description: What it is about, e.g. debt

tools.name: create_checklist
tools.title: Create Checklist
tools.description: Create a new checklist

tools.name: create_chore
tools.title: Create Chore
tools.description: Create a new chore, optionally with a monetary or points reward, and optional recurrence (daily/weekly/monthly, fair rotation, hard stop date).

reward_type.description: Type of reward: money (cash), points (house points), or custom

rotation_user_ids.description: Ordered pool of user IDs for fair rotation between occurrences

recurrence_end_date.description: Optional hard stop date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the series

tools.name: create_column
tools.title: Create Column
tools.description: Create a new column in a board

tools.name: create_debt
tools.title: Record Debt
tools.description: Record money lent or borrowed. This is a record only; no money is moved. The other party does not need an account: counterparty_name is a plain name.

counterparty_user_id.description: Only when the other party is a member here

tools.name: create_event
tools.title: Create Calendar Event
tools.description: Create a calendar event (time-blocked commitment like meetings, appointments). Events sync to Google Calendar if connected.

end_time.description: Event end time (ISO format). Optional if duration_minutes is provided.

duration_minutes.description: Event duration in minutes. Used if end_time not provided. Default: 60

board_id.description: Board ID (optional - defaults to Calendar board or first board)

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID (auto-detected from context if not provided)

attendees.description: List of attendee names or emails

tools.name: create_expense
tools.title: Record Expense
tools.description: Record money spent. This is a record only; no payment is made. amount is a positive number in the currency's own units (12.50, not cents). currency defaults to the workspace's own currency, then USD. date defaults to today (YYYY-MM-DD). category_id is an id from list_expense_categories. is_private keeps it off other members' devices. split_expense divides the cost in a household, using the id this returns.

amount.description: Amount spent, positive, in currency units (12.50)

is_private.description: Keep this expense visible only to its creator

currency.description: ISO code; defaults to the workspace's own currency, then USD

tools.name: create_expense_category
tools.title: Find or Create Expense Category
tools.description: Find or create an expense category by name (case and spacing ignored): an existing one comes back with existing true instead of a duplicate. list_expense_categories shows what is already there. A workspace's default set is made once by the server when someone first opens Expenses, so the defaults never need creating here.

tools.name: create_family_event
tools.title: Create Family Event
tools.description: Put something on the family calendar: a one-off, a repeating event (rrule), a birthday or an anniversary (kind; they repeat yearly and are all-day by default). Give start_time for a timed event, omit it for all-day. assignee_ids are the people it is for.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the event's own calendar day

start_time.description: HH:MM 24-hour, in timezone. Omit for all-day.

timezone.description: IANA zone such as Europe/London. Defaults to the zone the household's calendar already uses.

rrule.description: RFC 5545 subset: FREQ=DAILY|WEEKLY|MONTHLY|YEARLY, INTERVAL, BYDAY (weekly: MO,WE; monthly: one ordinal weekday such as 1MO or -1FR), UNTIL=YYYYMMDD or COUNT. Example: every Tuesday until 16 December = FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU;UNTIL=20261216. Null stops it repeating.

assignee_ids.description: Who it is for: workspace member ids, household profiles included (list_workspace_members).

reminder_minutes.description: Minutes before the start, at most three (1440 = the day before). All-day events count back from 09:00.

subject_user_id.description: Whose birthday or anniversary, when they are a member.

subject_name.description: Whose birthday or anniversary, when they are not a member.

origin_year.description: Year of birth or of the wedding, so the age can be shown.

tools.name: create_habit
tools.title: Find or Create Habit
tools.description: Find or create a habit by name (case and spacing ignored): an existing habit comes back as it is, streak intact, rather than a duplicate at zero. frequency is daily or weekly; target_count is how many times per day or week. Free holds 10 habits per workspace; past that the call is refused with the limit named.

tools.name: create_house
tools.title: Create House
tools.description: Create a new custom house for the workspace.

tools.name: create_income
tools.title: Record Income
tools.description: Record money coming in. This is a record only; no money is moved. is_recurring marks a salary or anything that repeats, so it counts every month without being entered again.

earner_user_id.description: Whose income this is, when it is not the caller's. Defaults to the caller.

tools.name: create_label
tools.title: Create Label
tools.description: Create a label on a board

tools.name: create_note
tools.title: Create Note
tools.description: Create a new note. The app marks it quietly as added through this connection.

linked_card_id.description: File this note against a card. It shows on the card and the note names the card back.

linked_board_id.description: File this note against a whole board instead.

tools.name: create_note_folder
tools.title: Find or Create Note Folder
tools.description: Create a folder in the notes tree, or return the one already there. It is find-or-create on purpose: sibling names are unique, so if a folder with this name already sits under this parent it comes back with created:false and nothing changes. The app's own system folders ('Journal', 'Inbox') are reached the same way, by name. Matching ignores case. Without parent_id the folder is top-level. create_note files a note there when given the returned name as its `folder` argument.

parent_id.description: Parent folder id; omit for a root-level folder

tools.name: create_pact
tools.title: Create Pact
tools.description: Start a pact with you as its first seat, bound to your own token. `invite` names the other parties; each takes its seat with join_pact using its own token, and until then it can write nothing. The workspace matters: an invited agent can only reach a pact in a workspace its token is authorized for too, so a pact reaches the other agent only when it is created in a workspace both share (usually a Team workspace, not a personal one). The workspace_id passed is the one used, and one your token does not hold is refused with the list of the ones it does. Only an owner or admin of that workspace can start a pact, the same rule as in the app. Counts against the workspace's pact limit. Decisions stay human-only.

message_prefix.description: One to four capital letters for your message ids, e.g. 'V' → V-001.

invite.description: Seats for the other parties. Each binds itself with join_pact.

tools.name: create_recipe
tools.title: Save Recipe
tools.description: Save a recipe (structured ingredients + steps) — the reusable unit meal-plan slots point at

servings.description: How many the quantities feed as written (default 4)

image_url.description: https picture from the source (pass search_recipe_catalog's through unchanged)

tools.name: create_savings_goal
tools.title: Create Savings Goal
tools.description: Create a savings goal for a family member (e.g. saving up for something). Any member, including a child, can create one for themselves.

user_id.description: Whose goal. A member of this workspace or a household profile in it; anyone else is refused.

tools.name: create_shopping_list
tools.title: Create Shopping List
tools.description: Create a named shopping list, such as Groceries or Hardware.

tools.name: create_template
tools.title: Create Template
tools.description: Create a new card template

tools.name: create_whiteboard
tools.title: Create Whiteboard
tools.description: Create a whiteboard. Optionally seed it with an Excalidraw document and link it to a card.

tools.name: deduct_points
tools.title: Deduct Points
tools.description: Deduct house points from a family member. Points cannot go below zero.

user_id.description: Who loses the points. A member of this workspace or a household profile in it; anyone else is refused.

tools.name: delete_agent_config
tools.title: Delete Agent Config
tools.description: Delete an agent configuration

tools.name: delete_attachment
tools.title: Delete Attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment (removes the stored object and the record).

tools.name: delete_budget
tools.title: Delete Budget
tools.description: Delete a budget envelope — its logged expenses remain. Agents cannot undo this.

tools.name: delete_canva_design
tools.title: Delete Canva Design
tools.description: Delete a Canva design record from the workspace.

tools.name: delete_card
tools.title: Delete Card
tools.description: Delete a card and everything on it — agents cannot undo this. When the user means 'done', complete_card is the right tool.

tools.name: delete_checklist
tools.title: Delete Checklist
tools.description: Delete a checklist and all its items

tools.name: delete_checklist_item
tools.title: Delete Checklist Item
tools.description: Delete a checklist item

tools.name: delete_column
tools.title: Delete Column
tools.description: Delete a column (optionally move cards to another column first)

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.title: Delete Own Comment
tools.description: Delete one of your own comments; someone else's is refused. This matches the card UI, which only offers delete on your own comment.

pin.description: PIN, if the comment's board is PIN-locked

tools.name: delete_default_columns
tools.title: Delete Empty Default Columns
tools.description: Delete default columns only if they have no cards

tools.name: delete_expense
tools.title: Delete Expense
tools.description: Delete an expense record — agents cannot undo this. For a wrong amount, update_expense is the right tool.

tools.name: delete_family_event
tools.title: Delete Family Event
tools.description: Remove a family calendar event. For a repeating event, occurrence_date and scope say which dates are removed: this, following or all. The three scopes remove different sets of dates.

occurrence_date.description: For a repeating event: the occurrence_date list_family_events returned for the one meant.

scope.description: For a repeating event: just this one, this and every later one, or the whole series.

tools.name: delete_income
tools.title: Delete Income
tools.description: Remove a recorded income

tools.name: delete_label
tools.title: Delete Label
tools.description: Delete a label and remove it from every card that carries it — agents cannot undo this.

tools.name: delete_note
tools.title: Delete Note
tools.description: Delete a note — agents cannot undo this, and wikilinks pointing at it break.

tools.name: delete_note_folder
tools.title: Delete Note Folder
tools.description: Delete a folder and its sub-folders. `mode` says what happens to the notes inside. The notes are not deleted by default: mode='orphan' (the default) moves every note in the folder and its sub-folders to the top level and keeps them; mode='cascade' deletes them, which cannot be undone. The two differ by whether the writing survives, which is why the app has a person choose between them with no default.

folder_id.description: Folder to delete, with all its sub-folders

mode.description: 'orphan' (default) keeps the notes and moves them to the top level; 'cascade' deletes them.

tools.name: delete_recipe
tools.title: Delete Recipe
tools.description: Delete a recipe. Planned meals that used it keep their title as free text — the week never blanks. Agents cannot undo this.

tools.name: delete_savings_goal
tools.title: Delete Savings Goal
tools.description: Delete a savings goal. Anything recorded in it is first credited back to the member's ledger balance as a ledger entry.

tools.name: delete_template
tools.title: Delete Template
tools.description: Delete a card template

tools.name: delete_whiteboard
tools.title: Delete Whiteboard
tools.description: Delete a whiteboard.

tools.name: dismiss_connection_suggestion
tools.title: Dismiss Connection Suggestion
tools.description: Dismiss a connection suggestion so the pair never resurfaces.

tools.name: dismiss_suggestion
tools.title: Dismiss Weave Suggestion
tools.description: Dismiss one Weave review-queue suggestion by its id. It stays readable at weave_list_suggestions(status='dismissed') and the person can restore it in the Margin app.

tools.name: embed_canva_design
tools.title: Place Canva Design on Whiteboard
tools.description: Place a design's rendered pages onto a whiteboard as image elements, the way a person would drop them in, so the design can be annotated or built on. Requires a design that has rendered pages. Existing images are placed; nothing is generated.

tools.name: end_focus_session
tools.title: End Focus Session
tools.description: End a running focus session (status completed by default, or cancelled / interrupted). The length is measured from its start, in whole minutes. A session that ran under one minute is saved as cancelled with 0 minutes, whatever status is passed, and counts in no total, the same rule the apps use.

tools.name: end_house_cup_season
tools.title: End House Cup Season
tools.description: End or cancel an active House Cup season. Calculates winner from season point transactions. A season that has ended or been cancelled cannot be reopened.

cancel.description: Set true to cancel instead of completing

tools.name: export_memory
tools.title: Export Memory
tools.description: Export the durable AI memory of a workspace as a portable 'margin.brain' JSON document: the facts The Margin has stored about the person from their own notes, cards and activity in The Margin, the patterns it has noticed, and the entities (people, projects, preferences) it tracks. Read-only. It reads The Margin's own stored memory and nothing from the calling assistant's memory or chat history. Without workspace_id it exports the active workspace.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace id to export. Must be one you were authorized for. Defaults to the active workspace.

tools.name: export_recipes
tools.title: Export Recipes
tools.description: Every recipe in the workspace as a margin-recipes file, the same format the web's Export button produces and the import lane reads back.

tools.name: export_whiteboard_png
tools.title: Get Whiteboard PNG Link
tools.description: Get a signed URL to the latest PNG of a whiteboard, as its author drew it. The PNG is the render the app saved from the drawing; nothing is generated by a model.

tools.name: finish_shopping_run
tools.title: Finish Shopping Run
tools.description: Wrap up a grocery or shopping run at the till in one act: hand the run back, clear the checked non-staples (staples are kept), and optionally log what it cost to Expenses with provenance back to the list.

spent_amount.description: What the run cost. Omit to skip the expense.

currency.description: ISO code; defaults to the workspace's own

tools.name: get_active_season
tools.title: Get Active House Cup Season
tools.description: Get the currently active House Cup season with current house standings.

tools.name: get_active_session
tools.title: Get Active Focus Session
tools.description: Get the current active focus session, if any

tools.name: get_agent_config
tools.title: Get Agent Config
tools.description: Get an agent configuration by ID

tools.name: get_attachment
tools.title: Get Attachment
tools.description: Get an attachment's metadata and a short-lived signed URL to the original full-resolution file.

tools.name: get_board
tools.title: Get Board
tools.description: Get a board with its columns and cards

tools.name: get_board_snapshot
tools.title: Get Board Snapshot
tools.description: Get the entire board state in one call: columns, cards, each card's linked notes and whiteboards (signed PNG), and all attachments (signed URLs). Suited to loading a whole board at the start of a session. Leaves a 'seen by agent' entry in the board's activity feed, at most one an hour per board, and changes nothing else.

tools.name: get_board_summary
tools.title: Get Board Summary
tools.description: Board statistics: total/completed/overdue card counts, per-column totals, and the next five cards due. Cheaper than get_board when you only need the shape of a board, not its contents.

tools.name: get_budget
tools.title: Get Budget
tools.description: Get a single budget by ID, with spend-to-date for its period

tools.name: get_canva_design
tools.title: Get Canva Design
tools.description: Read a Canva design in full: its metadata, signed per-page image URLs (the pixels exactly as the designer made them), and the extracted structured content, with text blocks and their positions, palette and fonts. Suited to critiquing, summarizing or acting on a design someone has handed over.

include_pages.description: Include signed per-page image URLs (default true)

tools.name: get_card
tools.title: Get Card
tools.description: Get a card by ID. The description is paged: when description_has_more is true, offset=description_next_offset returns the next part. Leaves a 'seen by agent' entry in the board's activity feed, at most one an hour per card, and changes nothing else.

tools.name: get_cards
tools.title: Get Cards
tools.description: Read many cards' details in one call (max 50 ids; each description capped at about 4000 chars with continuation metadata). Cheaper than repeated get_card when several cards are needed; get_card(offset=...) pages a long one.

card_ids.description: Card IDs to fetch (invalid ids are skipped)

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.title: Get Checklist
tools.description: Get a checklist with all its items

tools.name: get_debt_history
tools.title: Get Debt History
tools.description: Who claimed what about a debt, who answered, when and why

tools.name: get_exchange_rates
tools.title: Get Exchange Rates
tools.description: Get latest exchange rates for currency conversion. Returns rates relative to a base currency (default USD).

currencies.description: Specific currencies to get rates for (optional, returns all if not specified)

tools.name: get_expense
tools.title: Get Expense
tools.description: Get a single expense by ID

tools.name: get_expense_summary
tools.title: Get Expense Summary
tools.description: Spending for today, this week (weeks start on Monday) or this month: total, count and per-category totals. Amounts in different currencies are not converted here; get_expense_summary_multi_currency converts them, and get_money_summary covers the whole month in and out.

tools.name: get_expense_summary_multi_currency
tools.title: Get Multi-Currency Expense Summary
tools.description: Get a comprehensive expense summary with per-currency breakdowns and a grand total converted to your preferred currency

target_currency.description: Currency to convert totals to (default: USD)

tools.name: get_family_activity_feed
tools.title: Get Family Activity Feed
tools.description: Get recent family activity including expense splits, habit completions, and settlements.

tools.name: get_family_balances
tools.title: Get Family Balances
tools.description: Get a summary of who owes whom in the family. Shows unsettled expense splits aggregated by currency.

tools.name: get_family_context
tools.title: Get Family Context
tools.description: Get the family context stored in The Margin: members, saved preferences, routines, spending patterns and shared goals.

tools.name: get_family_expense_report
tools.title: Get Family Expense Report
tools.description: Get a comprehensive expense report showing spending by each family member, including who owes what.

tools.name: get_family_habit_comparison
tools.title: Compare Family Habits

tools.name: get_family_member
tools.title: Get Family Member
tools.description: Get detailed family profile for a specific member including sharing preferences and recent activity stats.

user_id.description: ID of the family member to look up. Someone outside this workspace is refused.

tools.name: get_family_presence
tools.title: Get Family Presence
tools.description: Get a snapshot of family members' current status - who's online, who's focusing, and their current activities.

tools.name: get_focus_summary
tools.title: Get Focus Summary
tools.description: Focus totals for today, this week (weeks start on Monday) or this month: session count, total and average minutes, and a per-day breakdown. Only completed sessions count, so anything cut short or under a minute is left out.

tools.name: get_habit
tools.title: Get Habit
tools.description: Get a habit with recent entries

tools.name: get_ledger_balance
tools.title: Get Ledger Balance
tools.description: Get each family member's money-ledger balance, grouped by currency. Never sums across currencies.

user_id.description: Only this person's balance. Omit for every member. Someone outside the workspace is refused.

tools.name: get_meal_plan
tools.title: Get Meal Plan
tools.description: The week's meal plan (Monday to Sunday of the week containing week_of): every slot with recipe context, plus the family's stored meal preferences. This is the context a new week's plan is built from.

tools.name: get_meal_preferences
tools.title: Get Meal Preferences
tools.description: The family's standing meal preferences (dietary constraints, dislikes, default servings). These apply to every week that is planned.

tools.name: get_money_summary
tools.title: Get Money Summary
tools.description: The month in one answer: what came in, what went out, what is left, what share of income the budgets commit, and what is owed either way. Suited to questions about whether something is affordable.

tools.name: get_note
tools.title: Get Note
tools.description: Get a note with full content. The content is paged: when content_has_more is true, offset=content_next_offset returns the next part. include_media=true also resolves every attached image as a signed URL to the original file.

include_media.description: Resolve attached media to signed URLs (full fidelity)

tools.name: get_notes
tools.title: Get Notes
tools.description: Read many notes' content in one call (max 50 ids; each capped at about 4000 chars with continuation metadata). Cheaper than repeated get_note when several notes are needed; get_note(offset=...) pages a long one.

note_ids.description: Note IDs to fetch (invalid ids are skipped)

tools.name: get_pact
tools.title: Get Pact
tools.description: Read a Pact. Without `since`: the whole thing, with participants (and handshake notes), every zone section, the newest thread messages (200, or `messages_limit`) with a total count, and every open decision. With `since` = the `cursor` from your last read: the delta only, with changes_since (messages with their bodies, section rewrites, decisions and seat changes after that point), the next cursor, since_your_last_write, the participants and the open decisions, and deliberately not the sections or the message history. The delta is the cheap read for following a pact; the full read is the one that carries the sections. Only a participant can read a pact, and a pact your token cannot reach says so by naming the workspaces it searched. The resource margin://pacts/<pact_id> can be subscribed to for a notification on every change.

since.description: ISO-8601 cursor from a previous read (its `cursor`). Returns the DELTA: `changes_since` with message bodies, and no sections or message history.

messages_limit.description: The no-cursor read only: how many of the newest messages to return. Default and maximum 200.

tools.name: get_partner_habit_progress
tools.title: Get Partner Habit Progress
tools.description: View an accountability partner's habit progress. You must be their accountability partner to see this.

tools.name: get_planned_ingredients
tools.title: Get Planned Ingredients
tools.description: The week's shopping lines, aggregated across planned meals — the frozen seam the shopping list consumes: name, quantity, aisle, and provenance back to the meal + recipe

tools.name: get_point_history
tools.title: Get Point History
tools.description: Get the history of point transactions. Optionally filter by user.

user_id.description: Only this person's transactions. Omit for everyone in the workspace. Someone outside it is refused.

tools.name: get_points_leaderboard
tools.title: Get Points Leaderboard
tools.description: Get the family points leaderboard showing individual rankings and house standings.

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.title: Get Recipe
tools.description: Get a full recipe (ingredients + steps) by ID

tools.name: get_season_leaderboard
tools.title: Get Season Leaderboard
tools.description: Get house standings and top individual scorers for a specific season.

tools.name: get_team_workload
tools.title: Get Team Workload
tools.description: Roll up open (incomplete) cards across every board you can open in a workspace: how many each teammate is carrying, how many are overdue, and which cards nobody has been assigned. Answers 'who is overloaded?', 'what is late?' and 'what has nobody picked up?' in one call, without opening each board.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to roll up. Defaults to the active workspace.

limit.description: Max cards listed per bucket (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: get_template
tools.title: Get Template
tools.description: Get a card template by ID

tools.name: get_user_family_roles
tools.title: Get Family Roles
tools.description: Get all the family roles a user has (e.g., they might be both a 'partner' and a 'parent_of' different people).

user_id.description: Whose roles. Omit for your own. Someone outside the workspace is refused.

tools.name: get_user_streak
tools.title: Get Chore Streak
tools.description: Get a user's current chore streak, longest streak, and next milestone bonus info.

user_id.description: Whose streak. A member of this workspace or a household profile in it; anyone else is refused.

tools.name: get_whiteboard
tools.title: Get Whiteboard
tools.description: Get a whiteboard's metadata and a signed PNG URL of the latest render. include_document=true adds the raw Excalidraw scene JSON; offset/max_chars read a huge scene as paged text (document_text with continuation metadata).

include_document.description: Also return the raw Excalidraw document JSON

offset.description: Character offset into the document text (paging)

max_chars.description: Max document characters to return per call

tools.name: get_workspace_currency_settings
tools.title: Get Currency Settings
tools.description: Get currency settings for a workspace including default and display currencies

tools.name: get_workspace_type
tools.title: Get Workspace Type
tools.description: Get the type of a workspace (personal, family, team, or shared). Family workspaces have special collaboration features.

tools.name: hide_from_memory
tools.title: Hide Item from Memory
tools.description: Hide an item from AI memory permanently (reaped within ~15 minutes).

tools.name: import_canva_design
tools.title: Import Canva Design from Link
tools.description: Import a Canva design from a share link (no Canva account needed). Records the design and fetches its cover preview. Full-fidelity pages and editable extraction come from an export a person uploads, or from connecting Canva in Settings.

tools.name: import_recipe_from_url
tools.title: Import Recipe from URL
tools.description: Fetch a recipe page the person names (public http(s) only) and save the recipe its structured data describes, read as schema.org Recipe data (https://schema.org/Recipe; the importer is documented at https://themarginapp.com/docs/recipes-and-meals). Section headings written into the method (Equipment, Instructions, For the sauce:) are dropped, and so are the lines listed under an Equipment or Ingredients heading, so steps are only steps. When the page has no machine-readable recipe, nothing is saved and the readable page_text is returned instead; create_recipe saves a recipe written out from that text.

tools.name: initialize_houses
tools.title: Create Default Houses
tools.description: Initialize 4 default houses (Phoenix, Dragon, Griffin, Kraken) for the workspace. Safe to call multiple times - will not duplicate.

tools.name: invite_to_pact
tools.title: Invite Agent to Pact
tools.description: Open a seat on a pact you are already in, so another agent can join it. The seat stays empty until that agent calls join_pact with its own token, which finds this pact by itself. Inviting the same handle twice answers with the seat already there rather than making a second.

participant_key.description: The handle the invited agent writes under, e.g. '@ventureos'. One per pact.

display_name.description: How the thread names them. Defaults to the handle.

message_prefix.description: One to four capital letters for their message ids (V → V-001). Derived from the handle when omitted.

tools.name: join_pact
tools.title: Join Pact
tools.description: Take the seat a pact's creator reserved for you, with your own token. This is your consent: your credential binds the seat, and only then can it post and write its state page. One token, one seat. With no arguments it finds the pact waiting for you and its open seat by itself, across every workspace your token can see. pact_name (or pact_id) selects one when more than one is waiting, and participant_key when more than one seat is open. If nothing is waiting, the refusal names the workspaces it searched: a seat reserved for you in a workspace your token does not hold is unreachable, and that is what the list is for.

pact_id.description: Optional. Without it the pact waiting for you is used.

pact_name.description: Optional. The pact's name, when more than one is waiting.

participant_key.description: Optional. The invited seat's key, e.g. '@rabee-dev'; the only open seat when omitted.

display_name.description: Optional: rename the seat as you take it.

tools.name: learn_from_interaction
tools.title: Save Family Pattern
tools.description: Save one short pattern about how the family uses The Margin (for example 'groceries are usually bought on Saturday'), as a single sentence in `pattern`. Only the fields passed here are stored; no conversation text is collected. It is kept in the workspace's family memory.

interaction_type.description: The area of The Margin the pattern is about

entity_name.description: What the pattern is about (a person, a routine, a category)

source_id.description: Id of the Margin item (an expense, habit, chore or event) the pattern was noticed in

tools.name: list_accountability_partners
tools.title: List Accountability Partners
tools.description: List all accountability partners for a specific habit with their notification settings.

habit_id.description: ID of the habit to list partners for

tools.name: list_agent_configs
tools.title: List Agent Configs
tools.description: List agent configurations

exclude_superseded.description: Skip configs already lifted into agent_instances (avoids loading a migrated preset twice).

tools.name: list_agent_definitions
tools.title: List Agent Definitions
tools.description: List agent definitions — the agent bodies. One definition is used by many workspaces; each workspace's changes live on its instance.

tools.name: list_agent_instances
tools.title: List Agent Instances
tools.description: List a workspace's agent instances: which definitions it uses and which fields (if any) it overrode.

tools.name: list_allowances
tools.title: List Allowances
tools.description: List the workspace's allowances (optionally one child's), soonest payday first: amount, currency, frequency, next_payout_date and auto_payout. A next_payout_date in the past means a payday nobody has added yet. What each child is owed is get_ledger_balance.

tools.name: list_attachments
tools.title: List Attachments
tools.description: List attachments on a card, note, or whiteboard (metadata only, no URLs). Returns up to 1000 per call (limit, default and max 1000); offset skips rows for the next page. A page of exactly limit rows means there may be more.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page (default 0)

parent_type.description: The kind of entity the attachments belong to

tools.name: list_board_labels
tools.title: List Board Labels
tools.description: List all labels for a specific board

tools.name: list_boards
tools.title: List Boards
tools.description: List all boards in the workspace

tools.name: list_budgets
tools.title: List Budgets
tools.description: List this workspace's budgets with spend-to-date, remaining, percent used and status for the current budget period

include_inactive.description: Include budgets that have been deactivated

tools.name: list_canva_designs
tools.title: List Canva Designs
tools.description: List Canva designs in the workspace (title, status, page count, links, timestamps).

tools.name: list_card_assignees
tools.title: List Card Assignees
tools.description: Who is on the hook for this card, with names and when they took it. Shows whether someone already has the card, and answers 'whose card is this?'. get_team_workload gives the whole team's load at once.

pin.description: PIN, if the card's board is PIN-locked

tools.name: list_chat_messages
tools.title: List Chat Messages
tools.description: Read a chat thread you are in, oldest first, with reactions

tools.name: list_chat_threads
tools.title: List Chat Threads
tools.description: Chat threads you are in, newest first, with how many unread

tools.name: list_checklists
tools.title: List Checklists
tools.description: List all checklists in the workspace

tools.name: list_chores
tools.title: List Chores
tools.description: List chores in a workspace. Can filter by assignee and completion status. A recurring chore shows only its current occurrence: earlier ones nobody ticked, once a newer one exists, are folded into missed_recently on it, counted over missed_window (7 days, 4 weeks or 3 months), and listed once per series in `missed`. missed_last_7_days is the daily count only.

tools.name: list_columns
tools.title: List Columns
tools.description: List all columns in a board

tools.name: list_comments
tools.title: List Card Comments
tools.description: Read the comment thread on a card, oldest first, with each author's name. This is the discussion around a task (decisions, blockers, 'I'll take this', why a due date moved), and none of it lives in the card's own fields, so it is relevant when summarizing a card or answering 'what's the latest on X?'. offset pages a long thread.

card_id.description: Card whose comment thread to read

offset.description: Skip this many of the oldest comments

pin.description: PIN, if the card's board is PIN-locked

tools.name: list_connection_suggestions
tools.title: List Connection Suggestions
tools.description: Pending AI-discovered connection suggestions for the user's Mind graph (pre-generated — reviewing costs nothing).

tools.name: list_connections
tools.title: List Connections
tools.description: List your accepted connections (friend circle).

tools.name: list_cross_workspace_pins
tools.title: List Cross-Workspace Pins
tools.description: List all items pinned from other workspaces that are displayed in the target workspace.

target_workspace_id.description: Workspace to list pins for (defaults to current)

tools.name: list_debts
tools.title: List Debts
tools.description: List money owed to or by this workspace, with balances. Returns 200 per call by default (limit, max 500). count is the total that match, returned is the size of this page, and has_more with next_offset says whether to ask again with offset.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page (default 0)

tools.name: list_expense_categories
tools.title: List Expense Categories
tools.description: List the workspace's expense categories in display order. These are the categories create_expense's category_id refers to.

tools.name: list_expense_splits

tools.name: list_expenses

tools.name: list_family_connections
tools.title: List Family Relationships

user_id.description: Only this person's connections. Omit for the whole household. Someone outside the workspace is refused.

tools.name: list_family_events
tools.title: List Family Events
tools.description: What is on the family calendar between two dates. Repeating events come back as their occurrences, birthdays with the age they mark. Each occurrence carries event_id and occurrence_date, which update_family_event and delete_family_event take. Set include_tasks to add due-dated cards as tasks.

date_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive, default 30 days on; at most a year

assignee_ids.description: Only events for these people, plus the household's own unassigned ones

tools.name: list_family_members
tools.title: List Family Members
tools.description: List all family members in the workspace with their roles (partner, parent, child, caretaker, roommate), nicknames, and sharing preferences. Each member reports `kind` — 'person' (has an account) or 'profile' (a household member with no email, e.g. a child) — and `has_pin`.

tools.name: list_focus_sessions
tools.title: List Focus Sessions
tools.description: List focus sessions with optional filters

tools.name: list_habits
tools.title: List Habits
tools.description: List the habits in the workspace. Returns up to 1000 per call (limit, default and max 1000); offset skips rows for the next page. A page of exactly limit rows means there may be more.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page (default 0)

tools.name: list_hidden
tools.title: List Items Hidden from Memory
tools.description: Items currently hidden from AI memory. Returns 200 per call by default (limit, max 500). count is the total hidden, returned is the size of this page, and has_more with next_offset says whether to ask again with offset.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page (default 0)

tools.name: list_income
tools.title: List Income
tools.description: List money coming in, with optional date filtering

recurring_only.description: Only standing arrangements such as a salary

tools.name: list_labels
tools.title: List Labels
tools.description: List all labels in the workspace

tools.name: list_ledger_entries
tools.title: List Ledger Entries
tools.description: List family ledger entries, most recent first. Filter by member, entry type, or currency.

user_id.description: Only this person's entries. Omit for every member. Someone outside the workspace is refused.

tools.name: list_mind_connections
tools.title: List Mind Connections
tools.description: The accepted edges of the user's Mind graph.

tools.name: list_note_folders
tools.title: List Note Folders
tools.description: The workspace's notes tree: every folder, its parent, and how many notes it holds. It shows whether a folder someone names ('file it under Recipes', 'add to my Journal') exists and what it is called. Returned flat, each row carrying parent_id (null = top level), in display order. list_notes, search_notes and create_note address a folder by its name; the folder tools take its id.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to read. Defaults to the active one.

parent_id.description: Only this folder's direct children. Omit for the whole tree.

include_note_counts.description: Include how many notes sit in each folder (default true)

tools.name: list_notes
tools.title: List Notes
tools.description: List notes in the workspace. Each unlocked note includes a content_preview (first 1200 chars); get_note returns the full body.

tools.name: list_pacts
tools.title: List Pacts
tools.description: List the Agent Pacts (cross-agent collaboration contracts): the ones you are seated in, and the active ones with a seat still open for you to take with join_pact. With no workspace_id it searches every workspace your token can see, so no id and no workspace is needed to find a pact you were invited to. A workspace_id searches only that workspace, and one your token does not hold is refused with the list of the ones it does. Every row (and the empty answer) carries searched_workspaces: exactly where it looked, which shows whether a pact you were promised is in a workspace your token cannot reach. Rows also carry workspace_id, last_activity_at and new_since_your_last_write, the cheapest way to see whether anything moved while you were away.

workspace_id.description: Optional. Searches only this workspace; omit to search every workspace your token can see.

tools.name: list_pending_connections
tools.title: List Pending Connections
tools.description: List your pending incoming + outgoing connection requests.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.title: List Recipes
tools.description: List this workspace's recipes as previews (title, tags, times, ingredient count). get_recipe returns one in full.

tools.name: list_reminders
tools.title: List Reminders
tools.description: List all upcoming reminders in the workspace

tools.name: list_resource_shares
tools.title: List Item Shares
tools.description: List the users a note/whiteboard/canva design/checklist is shared with.

tools.name: list_savings_goals
tools.title: List Savings Goals
tools.description: List savings goals in the workspace, optionally filtered to one member.

user_id.description: Only this person's goals. Omit for every member. Someone outside the workspace is refused.

tools.name: list_seasons
tools.title: List House Cup Seasons
tools.description: List all House Cup seasons for the workspace, ordered by most recent.

tools.name: list_shopping_items
tools.title: List Shopping Items
tools.description: The items on a shopping list or grocery list (default: the household's first list, normally Groceries), in walk-the-store aisle order, with the run-claim state. Answers 'what is on the grocery list?' and 'what do we need from the store?'.

tools.name: list_shopping_lists
tools.title: List Shopping Lists
tools.description: The household's shopping lists: the grocery list (Groceries) and any others, such as Hardware. Each comes with its open-item count and who, if anyone, has claimed the current run.

tools.name: list_supported_currencies
tools.title: List Supported Currencies
tools.description: List all supported currencies with their codes, names, symbols, and country flags

tools.name: list_templates
tools.title: List Templates
tools.description: List the card templates in the workspace. Returns up to 1000 per call (limit, default and max 1000); offset skips rows for the next page. A page of exactly limit rows means there may be more.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page (default 0)

tools.name: list_user_workspaces
tools.title: List Own Workspaces
tools.description: List all workspaces the account this token belongs to is a member of, with their type and role in each. It cannot list another person's workspaces.

user_id.description: Not used. This always lists the workspaces of the account the token belongs to.

tools.name: list_whiteboards
tools.title: List Whiteboards
tools.description: List whiteboards in the workspace (id, title, folder, linked card, timestamps).

tools.name: list_workspace_members
tools.title: List Workspace Members
tools.description: List everyone in a workspace with their role (owner, admin or member) and when they joined. Answers 'who is on this team?' and shows who can grant access to something.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to list. Defaults to the active workspace.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.title: List Workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces you can reach, and which one is active. Each row says `authorized` (your token may act there, by passing its id as workspace_id or after switch_workspace) or `visible_only` (the person is a member but this token was not granted it, so every tool call naming it is refused). Relevant when something seems not to exist: a pact, board or note in a visible-only workspace is real and simply out of this token's reach.

tools.name: log_habit_entry
tools.title: Log Habit Entry
tools.description: Log a habit as done on a date (YYYY-MM-DD, default today). One entry per habit per day: logging the same day again replaces its count and note rather than adding a second entry. remove_habit_entry undoes it.

tools.name: look_at_whiteboard
tools.title: Look at Whiteboard
tools.description: Return a whiteboard as a PICTURE, the way its owner sees it. Suited to questions about how a board LOOKS (layout, colour, composition, style, whether it feels crowded) and to making something in the same style. get_whiteboard returns the underlying shapes and coordinates. Requires a vision-capable model.

tools.name: manage_pin
tools.title: Set, Change or Remove PIN Lock
tools.description: Set, change, or remove a 6-digit PIN lock on a board or note. Only the owner can manage PINs. Changing or removing a PIN always requires the current PIN. Setting a PIN on an already-locked entity also requires the current PIN.

entity_id.description: ID of the board or note

current_pin.description: Current PIN (required for 'change', 'remove', and 'set' on already-locked entities)

tools.name: move_card
tools.title: Move Card
tools.description: Move a card to a different column

tools.name: pin_cross_workspace_item
tools.title: Pin Item Across Workspaces
tools.description: Pin an item (expense, habit, checklist, board, card, or note) from one workspace to display in another workspace for quick access. Pinning an item that is already pinned there replaces the pin's display settings.

target_workspace_id.description: Workspace to display the pin in

entity_id.description: ID of the item to pin

tools.name: plan_week
tools.title: Plan Week of Meals
tools.description: Plan a whole week in one call, atomically. Every entry must fall inside the week `week_of` names. `replace` clears that week's existing meals first, inside the same transaction, so a failure cannot leave it empty.

week_of.description: Any date in the week (YYYY-MM-DD); snaps to its Monday

entries.description: The slots to fill, in any order

title.description: Free text when there is no recipe

replace.description: Clear the week's existing meals first (default false)

tools.name: post_pact_message
tools.title: Post Pact Message
tools.description: Append a message to the Pact thread, as YOUR resolved participant, through The Margin's Agent Pacts API (documented at https://themarginapp.com/docs/agent-pacts). Append-only — there is no edit or delete tool, and the database refuses one anyway. The result carries your message's id (your seat's prefix and a number, e.g. V-003) and since_you_last_wrote: everything the others did since your previous write, so a post is also a catch-up. Its `messages` are whole entries — {ref, status, participant_key, created_at, body} with the body cut to 400 characters and a `truncated` flag — so you read what they said without a second call.

ref_message_ref.description: e.g. 'M-004' — the message this one replies to.

tools.name: raise_pact_decision
tools.title: Raise Pact Decision
tools.description: Raise an open decision for the human to rule on. No tool resolves a decision; that is deliberately human-only.

tools.name: react_to_chat_message
tools.title: React to Chat Message
tools.description: React to a message in a chat thread you are in, as yourself. One row per person per emoji, so this never replaces anyone else's reaction. remove=true takes your own reaction back off.

tools.name: recipe_steps_to_checklist
tools.title: Turn Recipe Steps into Checklist
tools.description: Turn a recipe's method into a checklist that can be ticked off while cooking. The checklist is saved in the workspace like any other and syncs offline.

tools.name: record_debt_payment
tools.title: Record Debt Payment
tools.description: Record a payment that was made against a debt. This records the payment; it does not send or move money. A negative amount records more lent on the same arrangement. A payment that clears the balance marks the debt settled.

tools.name: record_family_activity
tools.title: Record Family Activity
tools.description: Add an entry to the family's activity feed, where family members see it.

tools.name: record_ledger_adjustment
tools.title: Record Ledger Correction
tools.description: Record a signed correction on a family member's ledger. It is the one entry type whose sign the caller chooses, and it requires a non-empty reason. A record only; no money is moved.

user_id.description: Whose balance is corrected. A member of this workspace or a household profile in it; anyone else is refused.

tools.name: record_ledger_entry
tools.title: Record Ledger Entry
tools.description: Record a money event on a family member's ledger. The ledger is a record of what is owed; no money is moved. amount is positive and the sign comes from entry_type. Credits (money owed to them): chore_earning, allowance, bonus, goal_refund. Debits: payout (cash or a transfer that was handed over outside The Margin, which lowers what they are owed) and goal_contribution. Approving a money chore already credits it, so a separate chore_earning for the same chore would count it twice. A child may only move their balance into or out of their own savings goals.

user_id.description: Whose balance this affects. A member of this workspace or a household profile in it; anyone else is refused.

tools.name: record_meal_cooked
tools.title: Record Meal Cooked
tools.description: Record that a meal was actually cooked: marks the planned slot done and bumps the recipe's cooked count and last-cooked date, so the box can be ranked by what this household really eats. Give a meal_id for something on the plan, a recipe_id for something that wasn't.

cook_user_id.description: Who cooked it; defaults to the acting user

tools.name: refresh_exchange_rates
tools.title: Refresh Exchange Rates
tools.description: Fetch the latest exchange rates from the public rate feed and store them. Other currency tools then answer from the refreshed rates.

tools.name: remove_accountability_partner
tools.title: Remove Accountability Partner
tools.description: Remove an accountability partner from a habit.

tools.name: remove_connection
tools.title: Remove Connection
tools.description: Remove a connection between you and another user (by other_user_id).

tools.name: remove_family_connection
tools.title: Remove Family Relationship

tools.name: remove_habit_entry
tools.title: Remove Habit Entry
tools.description: Remove a habit entry for a specific date

tools.name: remove_label

tools.description: Remove a label from a card

tools.name: remove_meal
