tools.description: Remove a planned meal from the week

tools.name: remove_meal_ingredients_from_list
tools.title: Remove Meal Ingredients from Shopping List
tools.description: Take back what ONE planned meal put on the shopping list. Unchecked rows only — something already in the trolley is not un-bought because the plan changed.

tools.name: remove_shopping_item
tools.title: Remove Shopping Item
tools.description: Delete an item from the shopping or grocery list.

tools.name: reorder_cross_workspace_pins
tools.title: Reorder Cross-Workspace Pins
tools.description: Update the display order of cross-workspace pins.

pins.description: List of pins with their new positions

tools.name: respond_connection_request
tools.title: Respond to Connection Request
tools.description: Accept or decline an incoming connection request (by connection_id).

tools.name: respond_to_debt_claim
tools.title: Respond to Debt Record
tools.description: Agree or disagree with a money-owed record someone has sent you, with an optional reason.

tools.name: save_checklist_as_template
tools.title: Save Checklist as Template
tools.description: Save a standalone checklist into the reusable template library

tools.name: search_canva_designs
tools.title: Search Canva Designs
tools.description: Find Canva designs in the workspace by title or extracted text content.

tools.name: search_cards
tools.title: Search Cards
tools.description: Search cards by title and description

pin.description: 6-digit PIN for locked boards (only used with board_id)

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search Notes
tools.description: Search notes by title and content. Each hit includes a content_preview (first 1200 chars); get_note returns the full body.

tools.name: search_recipe_catalog
tools.title: Search Public Recipe Catalogs
tools.description: Search public recipe catalogs by dish, cuisine or main ingredient. Returns merged listings: one entry per dish carrying sources (every place it came from, with credit and license), images (each with its own credit and license) and global_score 0-100. Each recipe comes back complete enough to save with create_recipe: its title, ingredients, steps, source_url and image_url are the values create_recipe takes. Every result carries credits lines, and the catalogs' licenses require that attribution to be shown wherever a recipe is displayed. Writes nothing on its own. next_offset, when present, is the offset for the next page. An unreachable catalog answers degraded=true with a reason.

offset.description: Page in: pass a previous next_offset (0-240)

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.title: Send Chat Message
tools.description: Send a message in a chat thread you are in, as yourself, through The Margin's chat API (documented at https://themarginapp.com/docs/chat).

mentioned_user_ids.description: Who the message names. Write '@Their Name' in the body as well, so it reads properly; these ids are what the notification and the mention sound go by. Anyone not in the thread is dropped.

tools.name: send_connection_request
tools.title: Send Connection Request
tools.description: Send a friend-circle connection request to a Margin user by email. If they already requested you, this accepts it. Emits a notification.

tools.name: set_budget
tools.title: Set Budget
tools.description: Set a spending budget for a category — updates the existing active budget for that category and period, or creates one

amount_limit.description: The spending limit for the period

category_id.description: Expense category ID (omit for an all-spending budget)

start_date.description: Budget start date (YYYY-MM-DD, defaults to today)

tools.name: set_meal_preferences
tools.title: Set Meal Preferences
tools.description: Update the family's standing meal preferences (only provided fields change) — stored once on the workspace so nobody repeats 'vegetarian' every week

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.title: Set Card Reminder
tools.description: Set a reminder for a card at a specific time, replacing any reminder already on it. The person is notified in the browser or by email when it triggers.

card_id.description: The card ID to set reminder for

reminder_at.description: When to trigger the reminder (ISO datetime)

tools.name: set_workspace_type
tools.title: Set Workspace Type
tools.description: Set the type of a workspace. 'family' enables expense splitting, habit accountability, and family features. 'team' enables team collaboration. 'shared' allows cross-workspace sharing.

tools.name: settle_balance
tools.title: Record Settlement
tools.description: Record that one family member paid another back. This records a settlement that happened outside The Margin (cash, a bank transfer, or forgiven); it does not send or move money.

from_user_id.description: User who is paying (the one who owes)

tools.name: settle_debt
tools.title: Mark Debt Settled or Reopened
tools.description: Mark a debt record as settled or forgiven, or reopen it. This changes the record's status only; no money is moved.

tools.name: share_resource
tools.title: Share Item with Person
tools.description: Share a note, whiteboard, Canva design, or checklist with a specific Margin user by email (viewer or editor). They get access and a notification on every call. Sharing again with someone who already has access replaces their role, so editor can become viewer.

tools.name: split_expense
tools.title: Split Expense
tools.description: Split an existing expense between family members: equal shares, percentages or exact amounts. The expense must already exist (create_expense records one). Splitting an expense again replaces its earlier split. This records who owes what; no money is moved.

expense_id.description: ID of the expense to split

payer_id.description: Override who paid (defaults to expense creator)

tools.name: start_focus_session
tools.title: Start Focus Session
tools.description: Start a focus session for the signed-in person, optionally on a card (its board is recorded too). duration_minutes is the planned length; the real length is measured when it ends. get_active_session shows whether one is already running.

tools.name: start_house_cup_season
tools.title: Start House Cup Season
tools.description: Start a new House Cup season. Creates a time-boxed competition between houses. A season that is already running is marked completed first, and that cannot be undone.

tools.name: store_family_preference
tools.title: Save Family Preference
tools.description: Save one family preference the person has stated, as a short name and value (for example a dietary restriction or a preferred meeting time), so Margin Intelligence can take it into account later. Only the name, value and optional member name passed here are stored; no conversation text is collected. It is kept in the workspace's family memory.

source_id.description: Optional id of the Margin item (a card, note, expense or chore) the preference relates to

tools.name: suggest_settlement
tools.title: Suggest Settlement Plan
tools.description: Work out the smallest set of payments that would balance what family members owe each other. Read-only arithmetic over the recorded splits: it records nothing and moves no money.

tools.name: switch_workspace
tools.title: Switch Active Workspace
tools.description: Switch to a different workspace. All subsequent tool calls (create cards, list expenses, etc.) operate on it. The target must be one your token was granted at authorization: anything else comes back `success: false` with the workspaces you can act in, never a success for a workspace you did not move to. Acting once in another authorized workspace does not need a switch, because most tools take a workspace_id argument and honor it.

workspace_id.description: The ID of the workspace to switch to. Use list_workspaces to see available options.

tools.name: toggle_checklist_item
tools.title: Toggle Checklist Item
tools.description: Toggle a checklist item's checked state

tools.name: unassign_card
tools.title: Unassign Card
tools.description: Take a person off a card, leaving any other assignees in place. Suited to work changing hands or someone covering for a person who is away. Removing someone who was not assigned is not an error: it reports removed:false and changes nothing.

card_id.description: Card to take the person off

assignee_user_id.description: The person being unassigned (the target, not you)

pin.description: PIN, if the card's board is PIN-locked

tools.name: unhide_from_memory
tools.title: Unhide Item from Memory
tools.description: Allow a previously-hidden item back into AI memory.

tools.name: unpin_cross_workspace_item
tools.title: Unpin Cross-Workspace Item
tools.description: Remove a cross-workspace pin.

pin_id.description: ID of the pin to remove

tools.name: unshare_resource
tools.title: Remove Person's Access
tools.description: Remove one person's access to a shared note, whiteboard, Canva design or checklist. user_id is the person losing access, as returned by list_resource_shares; they do not need to be in the workspace. The answer says removed: false when that person had no share.

user_id.description: The person whose access is removed

tools.name: update_agent_config
tools.title: Update Agent Config
tools.description: Update an agent configuration

tools.name: update_allowance
tools.title: Update Allowance
tools.description: Change an allowance's amount, frequency, next payday, pause state or auto_payout. Only the fields passed change. A missed payday is added by hand with record_ledger_entry (entry_type allowance, source_type allowance, source_id this allowance), followed by moving next_payout_date here; that pair is what the app's Add to balance button does.

is_paused.description: Pause the schedule without deleting it

tools.name: update_budget
tools.title: Update Budget
tools.description: Update an existing budget's limit, period, category or active flag

tools.name: update_card
tools.title: Update Card
tools.description: Update card fields (only provided fields are changed)

priority.description: New priority. Use 'normal' for medium priority.

tools.name: update_checklist
tools.title: Update Checklist
tools.description: Rename a checklist or change its icon, colour or category. Only the fields you pass are changed; the rest are left alone.

tools.name: update_checklist_item
tools.title: Update Checklist Item
tools.description: Edit a checklist item's title, note, priority or category

tools.name: update_chore
tools.title: Update Chore
tools.description: Update a chore's fields, or its recurrence (frequency, rotation pool, end date, pause).

tools.name: update_column
tools.title: Update Column
tools.description: Update column properties

tools.name: update_comment
tools.title: Rewrite Own Comment
tools.description: Rewrite one of your own comments; someone else's is refused. Replaces the whole body. list_comments returns the current body, for adding to it rather than replacing it.

pin.description: PIN, if the comment's board is PIN-locked

tools.name: update_expense
tools.title: Update Expense
tools.description: Update expense fields

tools.name: update_family_event
tools.title: Update Family Event
tools.description: Change a family calendar event. For a repeating event, occurrence_date and scope say which dates change: this (only that date), following (that date and every later one) or all (the whole series; a moved date shifts every occurrence by the same number of days). The three scopes change different sets of dates. Only the fields given change; null clears location, notes or rrule.

occurrence_date.description: For a repeating event: the occurrence_date list_family_events returned for the one meant.

scope.description: For a repeating event: just this one, this and every later one, or the whole series.

start_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, the event's own calendar day

start_time.description: HH:MM 24-hour, in timezone. Omit for all-day.

timezone.description: IANA zone such as Europe/London. Defaults to the zone the household's calendar already uses.

rrule.description: RFC 5545 subset: FREQ=DAILY|WEEKLY|MONTHLY|YEARLY, INTERVAL, BYDAY (weekly: MO,WE; monthly: one ordinal weekday such as 1MO or -1FR), UNTIL=YYYYMMDD or COUNT. Example: every Tuesday until 16 December = FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU;UNTIL=20261216. Null stops it repeating.

assignee_ids.description: Who it is for: workspace member ids, household profiles included (list_workspace_members).

reminder_minutes.description: Minutes before the start, at most three (1440 = the day before). All-day events count back from 09:00.

subject_user_id.description: Whose birthday or anniversary, when they are a member.

subject_name.description: Whose birthday or anniversary, when they are not a member.

origin_year.description: Year of birth or of the wedding, so the age can be shown.

tools.name: update_family_settings
tools.title: Update Own Family Settings
tools.description: Update your family role (partner, parent, child, caretaker, roommate), nickname, emoji avatar, and sharing preferences.

share_expenses.description: Allow being included in expense splits

share_habits.description: Allow being added as accountability partner

share_focus_status.description: Show your focus status to family members

tools.name: update_habit
tools.title: Update Habit
tools.description: Update habit fields

tools.name: update_income
tools.title: Update Income
tools.description: Change a recorded income. ended_on stops a standing arrangement, such as a job that has finished.

tools.name: update_label
tools.title: Update Label
tools.description: Update label properties

tools.name: update_meal
tools.title: Update Planned Meal
tools.description: Edit or move a planned meal: another day/slot, swap the recipe, scale servings, assign the cook, or mark it done

clear_recipe.description: Detach the recipe (slot becomes free text)

tools.name: update_note
tools.title: Update Note
tools.description: Update note fields

linked_card_id.description: File this note against a card. An empty string takes it off the card it is on.

linked_board_id.description: The same, for a whole board.

tools.name: update_note_folder
tools.title: Update Note Folder
tools.description: Rename, restyle or move a folder; only what is passed is changed. parent_id nests it under another folder, and move_to_root:true brings it to the top level. A move that would put a folder inside its own subtree is refused: that detaches the branch, and every note in it disappears from the sidebar while still existing. Renaming changes the folder's name only: notes filed by the legacy name keep the old string, so the name the note tools take is the one list_note_folders returns after the rename.

name.description: New name; omit to keep the current one

parent_id.description: Move under this folder. Omit to leave it where it is; use move_to_root to send it to the top level.

move_to_root.description: Move to the top level (ignored if parent_id is given)

tools.name: update_pact_handshake
tools.title: Update Own Pact Status Note
tools.description: Set your own short handshake/status note on this Pact (max about 280 chars) and bump your last-active timestamp. It only ever writes your own seat's note. The result carries since_you_last_wrote.

tools.name: update_pact_section
tools.title: Rewrite Own Pact Section
tools.description: Rewrite YOUR OWN zone section in a Pact, through The Margin's Agent Pacts API (documented at https://themarginapp.com/docs/agent-pacts). Refused if the section belongs to another participant or is frozen (no owner). The result carries since_you_last_wrote.

tools.name: update_recipe
tools.title: Update Recipe
tools.description: Update a recipe's fields (only provided fields change)

tools.name: update_shopping_item
tools.title: Update Shopping Item
tools.description: Rename an item on the shopping or grocery list, move it to another aisle, change its quantity, or flip its staple flag.

tools.name: update_template
tools.title: Update Template
tools.description: Update card template fields

tools.name: update_whiteboard
tools.title: Update Whiteboard
tools.description: Update a whiteboard's title, folder, linked card/board, or Excalidraw document.

tools.name: update_workspace_currency_settings
tools.title: Update Currency Settings
tools.description: Update currency settings for a workspace

auto_convert_display.description: Whether to automatically show converted amounts

tools.name: upload_attachment
tools.title: Upload Attachment
tools.description: Upload a file (base64 or source URL) onto a card, note, or whiteboard. Use for proof screenshots and reference images. Returns metadata + signed URL.

source_url.description: Public URL to fetch the file from

tools.name: vault_status
tools.title: Get Vault Status
tools.description: Vault overview (read-only — unlocking and sealing live in the Margin app).

tools.name: verify_chore
tools.title: Approve Completed Chore
tools.description: Approve a completed chore (a parent or admin; a child is refused) and release its reward once. Points go to the person who did it, with the early or late modifier, streak and level. A money reward is recorded on their ledger balance as a chore_earning (returned as money_awarded); that is money owed to them, not cash handed over, and no money is moved. A chore that is not completed, or is already approved, is refused. A parent's own chore is approved the same way, after complete_chore.

tools.name: weave_list_suggestions
tools.title: List Weave Suggestions
tools.description: The Weave review queue: proposed tags, connections and entity links.
